name: WatchSignal
overview: Shows when the next episode or season airs on the series page.
description: Adds one line to the series page with the next episode air date. When that release is the premiere of a season, the line says when the season premieres. Dates come from Sonarr when the show is in your Sonarr library, and from TVMaze otherwise.
